critical_code_review_comments: settings.py get_settings uses an in-process dict _cache invalidated on PUT only. With multiple backend workers this cache would drift across workers after PUT (stale reads from workers that did not handle the PUT). Single-worker preview is fine; flag for production scale-out.

settings.py update_settings validates primary_color regex (#RRGGBB) — good; but does NOT validate email format, phone, or iban (acceptable since UI is admin-only). Length limits also absent — admin could stuff arbitrarily long strings; low priority.
portal.py _acc_by_token leaks nothing beyond customer scope; portal_photo correctly double-checks (file must belong to a site owned by the customer). Good tenant isolation.
portal.py revoke_portal_token uses $unset on 'portal_token' so re-issuing generates a NEW token (secrets.token_urlsafe(24)) — good, old links cannot be revived.

checks.endorse_check correctly rejects non-alinan or non-portfoyde (400). Edge: `h['status'] == 'taslak'` check only rejects taslak but not 'reddedildi' if such status exists; verify progress_payments status enum. Not blocking.

portal.cleanup_test_data uses regex ^(TEST_|Test_|test_|TEST |QA_) across many collections and cascades to progress_payments/transactions/checks/payments/reminders/proposals/contracts/site_photos. Deletes test users by email containing 'test' (case-insensitive) excluding self and all yonetici. Reasonable guard. It does NOT delete files/objects in object storage — orphaned storage objects possible after cleanup; minor.
portal.cleanup_test_data: `report['total']` sums all deleted_count values AFTER the users key was added; verified total=sum(report.values()) returns a plain int ok.
Non-admin cleanup test only passes because require_role returns 403 — expected. Verified.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18, 1 skipped — no proposals exist to test dynamic company name on PDF/Excel)

All TEST_ prefixed. Settings restored to Devrantaş defaults by TestZZZRestore after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -n 0` because test classes have cross-class ordering dependency (TestZZCleanup must run after TestEndorse/TestPortal to wipe TEST_ data; TestZZZRestore after cleanup). Running with xdist loadscope (default pytest.ini -n 2 --dist loadscope) breaks the ordering because fixtures are per-worker and cleanup from one worker leaves records from another; always pass `-n 0` for this file. Iteration-1 (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) and iteration-2 (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py) remain compatible with the default pytest.ini config. Non-admin registration is only via POST /auth/register-sub (admin-only). Public /auth/register is removed. Email domain .local is rejected by pydantic EmailStr — use @example.com for synthetic test emails.
rca of the issue: No issues found in iteration-3 scope.
